text:
tara: Heads-up from preprod: SAST job for repo `payments-api` failed to attach evidence after a KMS rotate test. Deploys blocked until triage.

oscar: saw alerts. scanner logs show KMS 403 on AsymmetricDecrypt. looks like the scanner pod was using a cached key version. link: https://logs.internal/tx/61828-preprod -> `permission denied: cryptoKeyVersions.get`.

jin: immediate mitigation applied: restarted scanner pods and retried job, evidence attached successfully. but we should avoid needing restarts.

tara: proposed changes: (1) pipeline placeholder behavior: on decrypt failure upload a small placeholder JSON to evidence store with fields {scan_run_id, error_code, retry_hint} so triage can continue; (2) escrow only with strict ACLs + 24h TTL; (3) correlation id on scan artifacts and KMS calls.

oscar: +1 on correlation id. example: `SCAN_RUN=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_SHA}` and include in KMS request metadata. makes joins trivial.

jin: on RBAC: do not give scanner permanent decrypt; instead use time-bound grants via IAM token broker. POC: token TTL=3m, require OPA policy evaluation `allow_scan_token` and rate-limit grants to 2/min.

ci-bot: automated: opened ticket SEC-PR-6182 (preprod-scan-evidence-fallback) and created incident INC-6182-sast-evidence-loss.

tara: for audit logs: add `x-scan-id` and `requester_principal` as audit labels on KMS RPCs. also ensure CloudAudit logs surface key version and rotation_id.

oscar: suggestion for pre-rotation safety: run a `scanner-auth-smoke` job 15m before rotation that performs decrypt-check and uploads result to monitoring. If it fails, abort rotation.

jin: about vuln triage: when evidence is missing mark finding `evidence: provisional` and route to oncall with higher priority. add an automated follow-up to re-open when final evidence arrives.

tara: action items: - tara: write placeholder-json schema + escrow ACL draft (ETA EOD) - oscar: add scan-id to pipeline + KMS metadata PR (ETA tomorrow) - jin: build token-broker POC + OPA policy (POC 72h) - sec-oncall: update triage playbook for `provisional` findings (ETA 48h)

sec-oncall: noted. will add escalation rule: any escrow write triggers pager and sec-oncall review.

oscar: quick snippet to include scan id in GH Actions:

```yaml
env:
  SCAN_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-sast-${{ github.sha }}
steps:
  - name: run scanner
    run: ./scanner --run-id "$SCAN_RUN_ID" --out evidence/$SCAN_RUN_ID.json
```

jin: and pseudocode for token broker check:

```py
if opa.evaluate(principal, repo) == True:
  token = broker.issue_token(sa='scanner', ttl=180)
else:
  deny()
```

tara: thanks. will coord infra review after PRs land. tagging infra owner @oscar and sec lead @jin for visibility.

(emoji: :white_check_mark: from jin, :eyes: from oscar)
